source_snapshot.procedure: Match recipe; clear logs; change all/random Processor Configuration settings; save/reboot and confirm retention; Load Defaults/save/reboot and confirm SPEC; collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: No errors or reboot failure; changed setting persists; default matches SPEC.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly assigns interactive BIOS navigation and observation to a person but does not address unsafe all/random changes or evidence destruction.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; required exact platform/page/defaults, safe reversible matrix, incremental checkpoints, preserved logs, topology verification and operator-controlled recovery.

old_problem: The historical record awaited approval of a safe value matrix and recovery because Master directs all/random BIOS modifications and log clearing.
disposition_reason: ED-11 explicitly authorizes only safe reversible settings, one setting at a time, with approved target/profile and pre/post evidence, and prohibits all/random or unapproved security/provisioning values. That ruling supplies the missing core execution semantics. Exact page values, project defaults and platform recovery remain runtime configuration under ED-03/07/08/09/15, while existing logs are preserved rather than cleared.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2176, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, ED-11 and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2177 / Wistron-BIOS-00494-V004 / 0555ca7a0d08908e was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Apply ED-11 exactly: one approved reversible Processor Configuration setting or dependency group per checkpoint; never all/random.
Bind motherboard, CPU/socket population, BIOS build, exact page and revision-controlled Project SPEC defaults.
Qualified operator uses approved KVM/console, captures baseline/changed/retained/Load-Defaults/restored screens and checks POST plus CPU topology.
Preserve SEL/kernel/system evidence with timestamp markers; do not clear historical logs.
Load Defaults blast radius, boot/readiness/error limits and last-known-good/KVM/physical/CMOS recovery must be signed before save.
No BIOS setting, log, reboot, Load Defaults, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: ED-11 controlled Processor Configuration persistence and default-restoration validation
test_case.purpose: Verify that each approved safe reversible Processor Configuration value persists across save/reboot and that the scoped page returns to authoritative project defaults after approved Load Defaults without CPU-topology, POST or health regression.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator and maintenance window
Revision-controlled project-default and safe reversible value matrix
CPU topology, POST/readiness and error oracle
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records the baseline page and preserved logs, changes one ED-11-approved reversible Processor Configuration value or dependency group, saves and reboots, confirms POST/OS Ready and CPU topology, re-enters BIOS to prove retention, then invokes the approved Load Defaults operation, saves/reboots and compares every scoped value to Project SPEC. Capture each screen and pre/post log delta; stop at the first anomaly.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved setting persists at its checkpoint; every reboot completes within the signed readiness limit with unchanged expected CPU/socket/core/thread/NUMA topology and no prohibited new errors; after Load Defaults every scoped value equals the authoritative Project SPEC.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only for the approved matrix when screen evidence proves retention and restoration and all signed boot/topology/error criteria match. Any wrong value, no-boot/hang/crash, topology drift or disallowed error is FAIL. Missing project default/value/recovery oracle is BLOCKED; no unapproved setting is exercised or treated N/A.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact platform/page, defaults, one-at-a-time values/dependencies, maintenance approval, limits and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random, security/provisioning/ownership changes or an unqualified value.
Preserve existing logs and use timestamp markers; do not clear SEL, dmesg or system logs.
Operator controls every save/reboot/Load-Defaults/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, ED-11 authorization and platform/firmware identity
Signed default/value/dependency matrix and last-known-good plan
Timestamped baseline, changed, saved, retained, Load-Defaults and restored screenshots
POST/boot/OS Ready timing and CPU/socket/core/thread/NUMA topology after each phase
Restored configuration, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop at the first boot, topology or error anomaly and preserve evidence. The qualified owner restores the last-known-good setting through KVM or the signed physical/CMOS procedure; do not blindly reboot, clear logs or retry the value.

source_conflict.reason: The target and acceptance are consistent; ED-11 safely constrains the underspecified all/random instruction without removing persistence/default coverage.

blocked.reason: ED-11 resolves the unsafe core semantics; platform values and recovery are runtime project inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Platform/BIOS/page identity, Project SPEC defaults, safe reversible per-setting matrix/dependencies, boot/topology/error limits, Load-Defaults scope and operator recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED BY ED-11 AS PARAMETERIZED MANUAL TEST; RUNTIME PROJECT CONFIGURATION AND EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION REQUIRED; NO BIOS, LOG, REBOOT, DEFAULT, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: BIOS/platform owner and qualified KVM/physical operator
pending.unlock_condition: Populate and sign ED-11-compliant values, defaults, limits and recovery before execution; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.

external_authorities.application: Authorizes only approved safe reversible Processor Configuration settings one at a time and prohibits all/random and unapproved security/provisioning values.

project_authority: BIOS/platform owner signs identity, values/defaults, dependencies, criteria and recovery; qualified operator performs the manual workflow; end engineer owns verdict.
